chunks: It does not behove God to have a son. Too immaculate is He! When He decrees a thing He has only to say: "Be", and it is.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God having a son and how does He create?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal in refuting the Christian doctrine of divine sonship by affirming Allah's absolute transcendence (Tanzih) and uniqueness. It underscores the immediacy of divine will, where creation occurs not through physical procreation but through the simple command 'Kun' (Be), a concept often linked to the creative power manifested through the Imams as the 'Word' of God.
